overview.summary.one: {count} month with data for usual averages (excluding one-offs). Savings = income − usual net spending, before investing. Usual spending: {regular} · One-offs: {oneOff} · Assets / deposits: {assets}. Savings after one-offs: {savings}.
overview.summary.other: {count} months with data for usual averages (excluding one-offs). Savings = income − usual net spending, before investing. Usual spending: {regular} · One-offs: {oneOff} · Assets / deposits: {assets}. Savings after one-offs: {savings}.

chart.cash: Income, net spending and monthly savings
chart.title: {title} in {currency}
evolution.oneOffText: Large, exceptional purchases to put usual spending in perspective
categories.negative: Negative net reimbursements appear in the table; the donut shows positive amounts.
categories.rule: Usual spending excludes one-offs by default. Reimbursements reduce spending. Investments, assets and internal transfers are excluded from these categories.
transactions.rule: Negative amounts are outgoing. “Otros” marks transactions awaiting classification. The export includes every filtered line, including splits. Without dates, the entire history is shown.
balances.emptyText: History will appear when movements or snapshots contain balances.
balances.total: Consolidated balance for accounts with data: {amount}. Each balance uses its own date’s FX rate; this is not a valuation of every account on the same day. History keeps the original currency. Joint accounts have their own tab.
balances.priority: Snapshots take precedence over movements on the same day
joint.title: A separate space for what you share.
joint.rule: Only joint account transactions appear here. Your personal contributions already count as “Gastos comunes” in the overview; these account purchases are not added again.
joint.limit: The 200 most recent lines are shown.
optional.budgetsEmpty: Your budgets will appear when your management tool adds them to the database.
investments.summary: Monthly investment: {invested} · Assets and deposits: {assets}. Investment and asset flows are not spending; returns reduce the indicator. Holdings and budgets appear automatically when their tables contain data.
investments.recurringText: Your recurring series, in one place.
investments.documentsText: Your document metadata, without exposing server files.
